messages:
violet (infosec): Heads-up: we're rolling a stricter egress policy in eu-west-3 at 03:00 UTC. It will default-deny non-approved outbound CIDRs and may block legacy bootstrap hosts used by GPU onboarding.

omar (platform): Which legacy hosts? need to know impact to warm-pool and reserved onboarding.

li (infra): Quick check: onboarding nodes reach `keystore.eu-west-3.internal`, `bootstrap-legacy-1.redwood`, and telemetry at 54.36.100.0/24. In staging when that sink was blocked we saw `keystore: tcp timeout` and warm-pool stalls.

tess (sre): Metrics from staging: warm-pool fill dropped 70% -> 35% within minutes when egress tightened. Cold starts spiked.

violet (infosec): Compliance will approve a tightly-scoped, timeboxed exception if you provide exact FQDNs/IPs, an owner, a canary plan, and audit retention increase for those flows.

omar (platform): I'll open an ACL PR with the exact hosts and request a 24h exception limited to onboarding service accounts. PR: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/1319

li (infra): Canary plan: enable exception per AZ, max 4 nodes, smoke test `curl -sSf https://keystore.eu-west-3.internal/health` from a fresh node. Toggle script: `./ops/onboard --region eu-west-3 --az b --canary on`.

tess (sre): Rollback triggers: warm-pool fill drop >20% in 10m OR keystore 5xx >1% sustained 5m. If triggered revoke immediately and pause backfills.

violet (infosec): audit-bot, create ticket with PR link, approvers, and retention delta.

audit-bot: Created ticket AUD-2026-512 "Scoped egress exception eu-west-3 for GPU onboarding" assigned to violet, omar.

omar (platform): PR includes smoke test and canary steps. tagging @violet for approval.

violet (infosec): Approved for 24h. Require post-mortem and migration to proxied keystore path in next sprint. Remove exception asap. :white_check_mark:

li (infra): Merging PR and kicking off AZ canary in 10m. Will post metric pings.

tess (sre): Watching. Ping me for manual rollback.
